snippet.title: Grounded 2 - Developer Vlog 04: Beat the Heat
snippet.description:
Grounded 2 – Developer Vlog 04: Beat the Heat

It’s time, Ranger! Ominent Practical Technologies is proud to unveil the latest developments arriving this spring at the Brookhollow Park Facilities.
 
Lead Community Scientist Employee 347 breaks down what’s included in the latest update — from domestication breakthroughs and combat enhancements to unauthorized experiments (and one especially large problem with scales).
 
Learn about:
🦎 King Dozer — a massive horned lizard where heat resistance is strongly encouraged for any new challengers
🐜 Black Ant Hill — a brand-new colony tied to fresh scouting efforts and new domestication research
🚫 O.G.R.R. Lab PSA — for your safety, please do not unlock restricted labs and scan anything you were clearly not meant to scan unless you have authorization to release [REDACTED]
🐞 Buggy Progression — enhance your insect allies with upgraded stamina, healing, hatching benefits, new behaviors, and tier-based improvements through the Buffin’ Barrel
🧪 O.R.C.s Gone Rogue — modified O.R.C. insects are appearing in the wild with dangerous and deeply unnecessary enhancements
🏹 Bow Defense — new defensive training helps Rangers survive while keeping a bow equipped
 
From upgraded Buggies and new survival tools to unstable O.R.C. encounters and the arrival of King Dozer, Beat the Heat raises the temperature across Brookhollow Park. Ominent thanks you for your continued service and encourages all employees to attend the upcoming Spring Cookout, interns included. As always, good luck out there, Ranger!
